rationale: Both variants passed the same functional checks. Guion closely matches the relay flow with HMAC and payload validation, SQLite state, retries, and dead-letter reporting. On the seven-trial frozen case, its median was 0.157246s versus Python’s 0.756934s. That timing includes process and oracle-check time, so I treat it as workload-specific evidence, not a throughput forecast.
trial_observation: The acceptance command exited successfully. Both implementations passed all 9 cases and 98/98 checks, including malformed payloads, invalid secrets, retry limits, and dead-letter reporting.
